Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values

Class MandelaList

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values.MandelaList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Object>
public final class MandelaList extends Object implements Iterable<Object>
A Mandela list: an ordered, mutable sequence of values, written [1, 2, 3].

Backed by an ArrayList, which gives the two operations scripts use most — random access by index and append — amortised constant time. The value is a reference: passing a list to a function and appending to it there is visible to the caller, which is the behaviour authors expect from a collection, and the reason List is deliberately not a record.

Growth limits are enforced by the runtime (rt.Std/rt.Json) rather than here, so the container stays a plain data type and a hostile script cannot make a list outgrow what the host configured.
